audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose is right at TRICKY 7/10 (50.15% WR over 3733 games), but the lane's actual difficulty driver was never stated: Defiant Dance (W) reduces physical damage while charged, and Zed's entire damage profile is physical.
audit.why: Riot text for Irelia W: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Zed Q/E/R all deal physical damage, so a charged W is the single best answer to a Zed all-in and it is what makes an even-win-rate lane feel losing.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr, tradeGood, breakdown.trading, breakdown.carry and spikes[2].text around Defiant Dance eating physical burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart said Skill/Skill/Irelia for rows 4-6 while the content layer said Zed/Zed/Zed, and the full-layer whys for those rows already describe Zed winning.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Irelia x4 then Zed x3, matching the content layer and matching both layers' why prose. The full-layer sides were stale.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side Skill->Zed, phases[5].side Skill->Zed, phases[6].side Irelia->Zed, proposed as one atomic chart group. win[4..6] already read Zed, so no no-op content edits were added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Irelia was credited with a 'passive shield' in whys[0], early and spikes[2].text. Ionian Fervor grants stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit damage at max stacks — there is no shield. spikes[0].text also called the stacks 'Q (Bladesurge) stacks'.
audit.why: Riot text for Ionian Fervor: 'When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.' Bladesurge is the dash/heal, cooldown 10/9/8/7/6 at 15 energy, refreshing on a Marked or dying target.
audit.corrected: Replaced every 'passive shield' claim with the real Ionian Fervor / Bladesurge-reset mechanics; put real cooldowns (Flawless Duet 16s->10s, Bladesurge 10s->6s, Living Shadow 20s) into breakdown.cooldowns and the loading lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and merely restated 'her stun setup'.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s but refreshes on a Marked or dying target so it is rarely truly down; Living Shadow is 20/19/18/17/16s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with those three numbers and what each window permits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — misgendered and it never named the item or the heal source.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal: Bladesurge heals Irelia on every cast and refreshes on marked/dying targets, so extended trades are decided by Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names Executioner's Calling and ties it to the Bladesurge heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file's derived flags mark Irelia's E as 'grounding'. Riot's own description says only 'damaged, stunned and Marked' — no grounding.
audit.why: Per the brief's rule, when a derived flag contradicts Riot's description the description wins. No grounding claim was written into any field.
audit.corrected: Nothing asserted about grounding. Vanguard's Edge (R) terrain IS in Riot's text ('the blades form a wall') and was used only for the wall/slow claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: QA quality read against the approved bar found a factual or title/body defect that no lint class covers.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/irelia.json gives resource=Mana; Bladesurge costs 15 MANA. The text called it energy, which is Zed's resource, not hers.
